snippet.title: Fun Zone Omega Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for Fun Zone Omega, a post-apocalyptic RPG full of wonderful mutants!

Wishlist the game on Steam!

Music by Doffu. Most of the tracks are from the album Coffee Jelly:
https://doffu.bandcamp.com/album/coffee-jelly
